PFA Sirohi

PROVIDED RELIEF TO LIFE STOCK BY PROVIDING FODDER AND WATER IN BARMER REGION ACHIEVEMENT

Thousands of animals were affected due to famine like situation arised due to less rain in districts of Sirohi , Pali , Jaisalmer and most importantly BARMER region of Jodhpur division of Rajasthan state. Due to less rain there was not enough fodder, animals were losing there precious life. In this condition PFA Sirohi chose Barmer district for providing cattle feed purchased at very high cost from M.P, Gujarat and Haryana and provided relief to the animals. In this life saving work, SH. JAYESH BHAI SHAH trusty of Youth charitable trust VALKESHWAR , Mumbai and his team provided economic support of around 22 Lakhs . The work done by PFA SIROHI in this situation was commendable. The work was also appreciated by District Administration Barmer. Important NEWSPAPERS also highlighted this work done by PFA SIROHI in their important articles. It is an another milestone for PFA SIROHI PFA Chairperson Mrs. MANEKA SANJAY GANDHI is requested to provide Letter Of Compliment to Jayesh Bhai , Trusty of Youth Charitable Trust and Roshan bhai Trusty of Shree Surat Panjrapol Jivdaya so that these youths are motivated. Please send the letter of compliment to address below.
